authority.source: O_CHAT_PARALLEL control10, DESIRED_STATE control26, DOWNSTREAM_STATE control33, O_OPERATIONS control15 and fixed Phase-1 user constraints
authority.instruction: Keep all 19 intended existing non-primary roles active. Physical repair is same-task re-enable only. Never reduce the pool, reinterpret user-fixed constraints, or modify protected primary O authority.

prior_evidence_preserved.multi_agent_skip_marker_canary: falsified; presemantic witness plus useful continuation plus recurring-open marker was not sufficient for physical persistence
prior_evidence_preserved.consequence: Do not treat marker presence or presemantic witness alone as a lifecycle solution.

matched_runtime_metadata.stopped_cohort: Each of the four stopped tasks showed task updated/disable metadata roughly 63-64 seconds after its recorded last-run start.
matched_runtime_metadata.survivor_cohort: The fresh enabled survivor cohort generally showed terminal/update metadata roughly 21-23 seconds after recorded last-run start.
matched_runtime_metadata.evaluation_receipt_check: No new 2026-08-30 evaluation durable receipt was present at the inspected repository boundary despite a fresh evaluation run record.
matched_runtime_metadata.interpretation: This is a strong duration-boundary discriminator but not causal proof. Role content, terminal path, platform lifecycle policy, and duration remain candidate causes until a matched intervention survives subsequent boundaries.

reconciliation.direct_update_readback: All four same-task updates returned is_enabled=true.
reconciliation.point_in_time_pool: 15 initially enabled plus four distinct direct is_enabled=true readbacks gives immediate 19/19 absent concurrent transition.

selected_plan.name: matched_bounded_slice_lifecycle_intervention
selected_plan.why: Repeated stopping plus the approximately 63-64 second stopped-cohort versus approximately 21-23 second survivor-cohort separation materially raises the expected value of a bounded-return intervention. Applying it to one repeated CLEAN role first preserves a contemporaneous untreated cohort and avoids confounding the whole pool before causal evidence exists.

treatment.method: One highest-value bounded CLEAN Phase-1 slice per invocation, durable checkpoint/readback before optional additional work, then recurring-open return with exact continuation. Hard runtime termination is not an anti-stop objective; anti-stop is preserved across recurrences.

controls.survivor_cohort: other intended enabled roles under existing role methods
controls.comparison: At subsequent intended boundaries compare physical persistence, role-valid durable output, useful-output rate, and continuation correctness. Re-enable-only any stopped enabled_desired task before continuing.

selected_plan.switch_rule: If failure_evidence survives a boundary with role-valid durable progress while comparable untreated roles stop, propagate the bounded-slice method through the appropriate repository controls with per-role baseline preservation. If it stops too, reject duration-slicing sufficiency and branch to terminal-status/platform-lifecycle alternatives. If all survive, require additional no-reconciliation evidence before attributing the cause.

rollback.condition: If the bounded-slice treatment lowers role-valid useful-output rate, breaks exact continuation, or fails physical persistence, increment the affected role control again and choose a better lifecycle method; do not disable roles or weaken anti-stop.

exact_next_action: At the next intended boundary inspect physical state before semantic inference. Re-enable-only any stopped intended role. Compare failure_evidence config6 against the untreated repeated-stop cohort and enabled survivors using durable receipt/output evidence; propagate only on discriminating evidence, otherwise branch to terminal-status/platform-lifecycle alternatives. Keep Phase 1 open.
